evidence.rowLabel: Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders
evidence.paragraph: For the three months ended March 31, 2026, Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders was $125.1 million, or $0.68 per diluted share, compared to Net Income Attributable to Common Shareholders of $106.2 million, or $0.58 per diluted share, for the same period in 2025.
